purpose: Form INC-13 is used as the Memorandum of Association attachment when incorporating a company under section 8 of the Act.
who: Not stated in the Rules text

steps: Prepare the SPICe+ form for incorporation.
Attach Form No. INC-13 as the Memorandum of Association for a section 8 company.

File the application with the Registrar within whose jurisdiction the registered office is proposed to be situated.
